component.name: Kameraa
component.summary: Enhance your webcam and publish it as a virtual camera

description.p: Kameraa captures your webcam, enhances it (denoise, relight, sharpen, AI super-resolution, background blur/replace, face smoothing) and publishes the result as a virtual camera usable in Teams, Meet, Zoom, OBS, browsers and more. It runs locally and offline — no cloud, no account.
Note: enhancement improves perceived quality but cannot create true 4K detail a sensor never captured, and video-call apps cap what they transmit.
